companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
OUTsurance has been propelling the South African insurance industry forward for the last 28 years. As leaders in the field, we’re always looking for innovative ways to create digitally advanced solutions, without losing sight of our human values.

Youi is a company within the OUTsurance Holdings Group. Youi prides itself on being different. We've challenged the Australian insurance industry and we're always looking for ways to be better. Our unwavering commitment to being a great company to work for and providing awesome service to our clients drive our success. You can become a part of our success story.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
The Learnership is a structured work-based program, affording unemployed youth work experience in our company. This program gives unemployed youth workplace experience or an opportunity to practice the work skills in order to assist them in the future with their chosen occupations.

The successful applicants will enter into a fixed term Learnership agreement (not an employment contract). This is a learning opportunity for unemployed youth that has a passion for call center and would like to gain experience in order to pursue a career in the Financial and Insurance industry.

Working Hours

You will be required to work the following shifts based on a pre-determined roster:

  • Monday to Friday (06:00 AM to 15:00 PM) 

Public Holidays

You will be required to work a full day during South African Public holidays if you are scheduled on the day, unless it’s a public holiday in AUS.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Matric
  • Be a South African citizen
  • Computer Literate (MS Office)
  • No work experience required
  • Be between the ages of 18 & 35

additionalInformation.title: Additional Information
additionalInformation.text:
The YOUI Claims Learnership Advisor will report directly to the Team Manager and will work closely with the Claims team.

At OUTsurance our value of HUMAN is more than just a poster on the wall. It’s a key part of our culture and we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace that reflects the communities we serve. We actively encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In support of our Employment Equity objectives, we strive to create equal opportunities for all and also welcome candidates from designated groups who meet the role requirements.

An ideal candidate will be able to align their personal work values to the OUTsurance values of Awesome Service, Dynamic, Honest, Human, Passionate and Recognition.
